name: The Final Prize is Soup
source:
After a disastrous break up, Qian Hailu wakes up to find that she's dead. Luckily (or unluckily), she's been given a chance to turn back the clock and avert her death—as long as she can pass three rounds in the game of life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903060/The_Final_Prize_is_Soup/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
经历了一场惨烈收场的分手后，千海露一觉醒来，竟发现自己已经死了。幸运（或者说不幸）的是，她得到了一个让时间倒流、逆转死劫的机会——前提是她能在“人生游戏”中连闯三关。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903060/The_Final_Prize_is_Soup/]Steam[/url]]
